**P2 — Recheck replay assertions after cleanup collects logs**

If a duplicate `BODY` record from replay arrives during cleanup, this assertion has already passed. Balanced task boundaries allow cleanup to succeed, and `assert_case_request_lifecycles()` accepts the duplicate body when it occurred before wrapper return. The suite can therefore pass despite rerunning checkpointed user code. Preserve the replay marker/history and rerun `assert_replay()` against the final collected trace, including warm replay cases. Add a delayed duplicate-body regression.
